# The desktop's costs

Cycles of the reference configuration (D16-overlap) spent executing
instructions, less what the idle loop would have spent in the same
time; and that as time at 3 MHz.


## Booting

| | cycles | at 3 MHz |
|---|---:|---:|
| Start the VM and compile the prelude (408 lines) | 4,931,859 | 1,644 ms |
| Compile the desktop (1812 lines of Egret) and open its first windows | 31,270,317 | 10,423 ms |
| Paint the first windows | 3,520,770 | 1,174 ms |

## Idle

| | cycles | at 3 MHz |
|---|---:|---:|
| The event loop, a second with nothing to do | 186,000 | 62 ms |
| The same with the clock moving its hands | 542,836 | 181 ms |

## Where the cycles go

Each column is all the cycles from the event to the end of a short wait
after it (the idle loop's included), by the kind of function they were in.

| | an idle second | typing a character | print it: `2 ** 100` | opening the Browser |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Egret's interpreter (the assembly loop) | 69% | 54% | 35% | 40% |
| its slow path, in C | 0% | 10% | 6% | 3% |
| allocation and collection | 13% | 8% | 6% | 5% |
| drawing (the graphics library) | 0% | 12% | 28% | 41% |
| the window manager | 6% | 4% | 1% | 2% |
| Egret's primitives (prims.c, gui_prims.c) | 10% | 7% | 6% | 4% |
| the rest of the VM and the C library | 1% | 5% | 17% | 5% |
| all, at 3 MHz | 62 ms | 33 ms | 182 ms | 1,017 ms |
